about: Today's Sky Devotion for La Porte, Indiana, picked each morning by what the sky is doing (devotion/sky.js). By La Porte Weather Now. Scripture: KJV (public domain). Weather: National Weather Service.
forecastLine: Today: Sunny, high near 73°. Tonight: Mostly Clear, low around 53°.

entry.kjv: The LORD is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.
entry.text: A gentle day feels like one of God's tender mercies, and the psalm says those mercies cover everything He made: people, animals, fields and lakes. None of it is left out. Show that same care today to a person or creature near you.
